sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 660. Success value 100. 4x physical damage (Star).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Abstraction for 40 seconds with a success value of 110.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 150. Applies Beguilement for 60 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Changes Cost held to 50. [Demerit]
-Target: all allies. Applies Twilight for 120 seconds (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies Cost reduction and Unison gauge reduction; heals for 10% of damage dealt; boosts Break increase value by 40; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking. When in effect and an enemy is defeated, recovers 30% of your max HP; fills Unison gauge by 20; and debuffs/special debuffs are removed).
-Target: all allies. Applies Absolute (increases the maximum number of Attack Skills that can activate by 1) for 60 seconds.
-Target: yourself. Applies Skirmish for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; [Special] permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects; [Special] fill your Unison gauge by 3 and recover 5 Cost when using an Ability; [Special] restores CP based on damage dealt. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Savior Element (increases all stats by 120%, increases fire, water, wind, light, dark, time, and star elemental attack by 6, and increases Cost recovery speed by 10) to the allied Field for 120 seconds.
Boosts stats of Monsters of all elements by 50% when equipped in the Main Slot.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 and stat slot 2 by 35000

[Additional Unison Effect] Target: all allies. Applies kijin (increases max HP by 100%; nullifies debuffs; nullifies Unison gauge reduction; boosts Ability Power of critical hits by 50; increases attack Ability accuracy by 30%; permits piercing through damage reduction, damage reflection, and damage nullifying effects when attacking) for 120 seconds.
Lethargy and Frail Resistance Up by 50
Dark and Star Defense from Unison Damage +600
